description: This Java class 'ScorecardMapper' provides static methods to map scorecard data into Scorecard objects, associating questions and responses from a survey, and handling related data transformations and exceptions.

classes.name: ScorecardMapper
classes.description: Utility class for mapping scorecard data to domain objects, including methods for creating scorecards and associating questions and responses.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts ScorecardData into a list of Scorecard objects, associating them with a survey, user, and client, and setting their values and creation time.

methods.name: setQuestionAndResponse
methods.description: Associates a question and response to a scorecard based on IDs from ScorecardValue and the survey.
